name: gesher-freeform
description: Read, author and edit Apple Freeform boards: text boxes, shapes, sticky notes, bound connectors, diagrams and board lifecycle.

interface.shortDescription: Read and add to Freeform boards
interface.longDescription: List Freeform boards and read their items (text, sticky notes, shapes, connectors, images, files, links) with positions, sizes, colors and stacking order. Create boards and add text boxes, links, images and files; Freeform places and syncs them. Renaming, deleting and editing items stay in the Freeform app.
capabilities: Add text, links, images and files
defaultPrompt: Which Freeform boards did I work on most recently?
Summarize what is on my Freeform board 'Trip ideas'.
Add a link to https://www.apple.com to my Freeform board 'Trip ideas'.
